details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:3664-3686 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Unmapped reviewers now retry the same model instead of being skipped as `skipped_unmapped`.
  WHY: The default attempt budget makes the new `-le 2` guard false, so the failback path falls through and breaks the unmapped-reviewer contract.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:2885 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The contract test still asserts `skipped_unmapped` even though the reviewer failback logic no longer produces it on the default path.
  WHY: This is the CI assertion failure reported in the review output; the test or the logic must be updated together.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:236-533 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When prelude refactoring is enabled but assembly is skipped, placeholder collection reads an empty assembled prompt file and drops substitutions like `{{REPO_LEARNINGS}}`.
  WHY: Reviewers traced the bug to the placeholder-source assignment/conditional interaction; they disagreed on severity (MAJOR vs BLOCKER), so the highest severity is critical.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:30-33 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `emit_event.sh` is sourced without a fail-open guard under `set -euo pipefail`, so the script aborts before installing the no-op fallback stub.
  WHY: This breaks the documented fail-open behavior; reviewers split between MAJOR and BLOCKER, so the highest severity is critical.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:22-25 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `emit_event.sh` is sourced without a fail-open guard under `set -euo pipefail`, so Serena bootstrap can abort before the fallback stub and env writes are installed.
  WHY: This breaks the intended soft-failure path; reviewers split between MAJOR and BLOCKER, so the highest severity is critical.
- scripts/emit_event.sh:28-29 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The failure prefix is emitted as `EVENTS_EMIT_FAIL:` instead of the documented `EVENTS_EMIT_FAIL`.
  WHY: Colon-suffixed output breaks stable-prefix consumers and grep-based tooling.
- scripts/emit_event.py:63 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_emit_fail` emits `EVENTS_EMIT_FAIL:` with a trailing colon, not the documented stable prefix.
  WHY: This has the same prefix-matching mismatch as the shell helper.
- scripts/emit_event.sh:23-24 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED` only accepts a literal `true`, so common truthy values silently disable event mirroring.
  WHY: This is inconsistent with other repo feature flags and causes silent opt-out.
- scripts/emit_event.py:18 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED` only accepts a literal `"true"`, so common truthy values silently disable event mirroring.
  WHY: This is inconsistent with other repo feature flags and can silently disable the Python emitter.
- scripts/emit_event.py:28-31 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `GITHUB_RUN_ID` is interpolated into the JSONL filename without sanitization.
  WHY: A malicious or malformed run id can write outside `.events/`; `transcript_archive.sh` already sanitizes the same segment.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Update both workflow YAML and the shell/Python helpers they invoke"
  expected_change_site: consumer-facing workflow wrappers / workflow-templates/ and orchestrator paths that source the new helpers
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: workflow-templates/ do not yet source emit_event.sh or transcript_archive.sh; stage_workflow_support.sh only wires these for source-repo workflows, so consumer repos consuming @stable wrappers will not pick up the new helpers until their wrapper templates are updated.
- requirement: one independently mergeable PR per phase with per-phase default-off flags
  expected_change_site: stage_workflow_support.sh and the phase-specific workflow wrappers
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: this squash PR bundles Phases A–H into one landing.
- requirement: the new `## Decisions` contract needs paired validation in the CI matrix
  expected_change_site: test-and-mark-stable.yml, mark-stable.yml, ci.yml
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: `test_lint_plan_decisions` is only in ci.yml; the other jobs still only run the archival linter.
- requirement: scope-guard / untrusted-context protections should extend to the new identity-recall and compaction-rules blocks
  expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.sh / prompt templates
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: the new blocks are injected after the untrusted fence without additional sanitization.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- scripts/setup_serena.sh:22-25 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

- scripts/emit_event.py:63 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: Stable-prefix consumers expecting `EVENTS_EMIT_FAIL` will miss the message.
- scripts/emit_event.sh:23-24 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED` only accepts the literal string `true`.
  WHY: Values like `1`, `yes`, or `on` silently disable event mirroring.
- scripts/emit_event.py:18 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED` only accepts the literal string `"true"`.
  WHY: Values like `1`, `yes`, or `on` silently disable the Python emitter.
